a1-61.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Do
a1-61.scenario: Anna phones you from the library. She wants to know what you do in the living room and what you do in the kitchen.
a1-61.prompt: Tell Anna that you read in the living room and cook in the kitchen.
cues: Say what you do in the living room
Say what you do in the kitchen
a1-61.target: A nappaliban olvasok. A konyhában főzök.
a1-61.english: I read in the living room. I cook in the kitchen.
a1-61.canDo: I can say what I do, like olvasok, tanulok and főzök.
